instruction.text: Polly owns a flower shop. She divides her 50 pink flowers into fifths. How many flowers are in each group?
At the end of the day, Polly has 25 pink flowers remaining. Follow the steps below to find 25 as a unit fraction of 50.

hint.text: The answer to the first sum will be the denominator of the unit fraction.

instruction.text: Alex owns a pet shop. He has 63 clownfish. He divides them into sevenths to be put in different tanks. How many are in each tank?
At the end of the week, Alex has 9 clownfish remaining. Follow the steps below to find 9 as a unit fraction of 63.

hint.text: The answer to the first sum will be the denominator of the unit fraction.

instruction.text: Burt owns a small bee farm. He has 99 bees and divides them into ninths to go in separate hives. How many bees are in each hive?
At the end of the year, Burt has 33 bees remaining. Follow the steps below to find 33 as a unit fraction of 99.

hint.text: The answer to the first sum will be the denominator of the unit fraction.
